content.text: warn patients and guardians that abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting and/or anorexia can be pancreatitis symptoms needing prompt evaluation (valproate is ordinarily stopped if it's diagnosed); fatal hepatic failure has occurred, usually in the first six months, and may be preceded by malaise, weakness, lethargy, facial edema, anorexia and vomiting.
